segments.normalizedSource: The following Swift code demonstrates an implementation of this technique:
segments.contextBefore: The effect node uses a multiplication blend mode to apply its lighting effect to the sceneʼs framebuffer.
segments.contextAfter:
```swift
let lightingNode = SKEffectNode()

let light = SKSpriteNode(texture: lightTexture)
light.blendMode = .add
...
lightingNode.addChild(light)

let blurFilter = CIFilter(name: "CIBoxBlur",
withInputParameters: ["inputRadius": 20])

lightingNode.filter = blurFilter

lightingNode.blendMode = .multiply
```
